notes.claim_list: Historical Study 2 s2_analysis.R revision 6 remains the code target. Study 1 script/data and the deposited Study 2 activity-count data are additionally pinned. The activity-data path is /Study 2/s2_data_actions.csv; the script calls it Data/S2 text.csv.
notes.sol: Round 1 direct checks reproduce all six selected quantities. Study 2 activity data exist in OSF file 659c057d5e925a0bdc45b93e v1 (created 2024-01-08); revision 6 (2024-03-27) calls the wrong filename. A documented path correction from Data/S2 text.csv to deposited s2_data_actions.csv yields C1=2.110497237569, C2=0.976928449696, C3=2.301136363636 using the original expressions. The report independently says the author later fixed the called filename. Thus the historical P0 claim was false under R4: the input is present and no content changes are needed. Targeted Study 1 Model 1/2 checks also reproduce C4-C6 (singular-fit warnings recorded). Paper status is computationally reproducible within this source-supported scope. This is not a claim of a full end-to-end rerun of all analyses; other models remain supported by the human report. Audit scripts/logs are in model-gating/gold-set/audit/.
notes.claude: C1-C3 match, severity null: the deposited pre-revision-6 activity data file exists and the second labeller's direct checks establish that correcting the input filename is a lossless repair (R4 as amended). Paper computationally reproducible, alternative computational issues (R7); no technical-failure alternative. The C6 exhibit has been corrected to the social-desirability-controlled model; Study 1 inputs are now pinned. Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes.claude_blind_original_historical: Claim-list problem: C6 exhibit says 'model 3' but 1.48 is the model with social desirability bias added (code Model 2); the report's Table 1 (p.10) lists model 3 between-person b = 1.45, which I also get from model 3 (1.452473). Value itself reproduces. Study 1 has no version pin; I ran the current s1_analysis.R and s1_data.csv from osf.io/hpvsu (my edits: data path, dropped effectsize/interactions calls and the figure block; did not touch models). Study 2: no 'S2 text.csv' anywhere in the project; s2_data_actions.csv is probably the intended file, but renaming is not 'as shipped'. Sourcing the whole s2 script would halt at line 31, which is why 'technical failure' is an acceptable alternative, though the gold primary claims (Study 1, Study 2 main ANCOVA) run. Report does not give values for C1-C3, only that Figure 2/S4 content was irreproducible.
